claim: Atrio holds three Michelin stars in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide España
quote: Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey.

claim: Atrio revalidated its three Michelin stars in the 2026 Guide; Versátil maintained its one star
quote: El restaurante Atrio de Cáceres revalida sus tres estrellas Michelín en 2026 y 'Versátil' mantiene una.

claim: Atrio is located in medieval Cáceres, designed by architects Tuñón y Mansilla, and is a Relais & Châteaux member
quote: avant-garde cuisine that harmonizes modern techniques with respect for tradition and Extremaduran products

claim: The Atrio tasting menu 'Menú Degustación' is priced at €295 per person including VAT, themed around Iberian pork
quote: UN LUJO GASTRONÓMICO CON TRES ESTRELLAS MICHELIN — 295 € por comensal (IVA incluido)

claim: Atrio gained its third Michelin star in 2023 after holding two stars for 18 years; wine list is a 444-page hardback
quote: The list is displayed in a 444-page hardback book that can be purchased (currently priced at €88).

claim: Atrio's wine cellar holds 40,000 bottles; José Polo co-founded with Toño Pérez in 1986; third star awarded in 2023 Guide
quote: The restaurant achieved its third Michelin star in the 2023 Guide, after holding two stars for 18 years.

claim: The 22-course tasting menu incorporates Iberian pork in nearly every dish; wine pairing options range from €100–€170
quote: four, five or six glasses at 100, 130 and 170 Euro, respectively

claim: Atrio's tasting menu is €295 per person; average spend is €360
quote: Menu tiempos de sol: 295 € por comensal

claim: In October 2021 thieves stole 45 bottles from Atrio's cellar including Château d'Yquem back to 1806 and DRC Montrachet
quote: The haul included a vertical of Yquem going back to 1806 and dozens of bottles of Domaine de la Romanée-Conti Montrachet.

claim: The couple behind the 2021 wine heist were arrested in Croatia and sentenced to 4 years; stolen bottles never recovered
quote: The wine-thieving pair received their sentences for aggravated robbery in a Spanish court: 4 years in prison.

claim: José Luis Paniagua, head sommelier at Atrio, received the Michelin Sommelier Award 2025
quote: José Luis Paniagua, Premio MICHELIN al Sommelier 2025

claim: Atrio's wine cellar contains wines from 21 countries; the circular cellar was designed by architects Mansilla and Tuñón
quote: The wine collection contains 40,000 bottles, from 22 countries, from 44 producers, including 28 small boutique wineries.

claim: Versátil in Zarza de Granadilla holds 1 Michelin star — the only other starred restaurant in Extremadura
quote: Versátil – Zarza de Granadilla - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Versátil offers two tasting menus: 'Paseo Extremeño' (8 courses, €75) and 'Gran Paseo Extremeño' (12 courses, €98)
quote: menú 'Paseo Extremeño' con 8 pases a 75 euros y el 'Gran Paseo Extremeño' con 12 pases a 98 euros

claim: Only two restaurants in Extremadura hold Michelin stars in 2026: Atrio (3 stars) and Versátil (1 star)
quote: Extremadura has 2 restaurants with Michelin stars: Atrio (3 stars) and Versátil (1 star)
